serviceName: Web de Hablify en un subdominio
description: Points a subdomain (www, shop…) at a Hablify website: the ownership record Hablify checks and a CNAME to the website's address on hablify.es.
variableDescription: token: the per-domain ownership token Hablify generates (32 hex characters). It is an opaque single-purpose value on its own dedicated label (_hablify-verify), so it is used bare. site: the label of the website's free address (bar-ana in bar-ana.hablify.es); the target is always fixed under hablify.es.
